act_title: As the Burning Sun Sears Shadows

quests.title: As the Burning Sun Sears Shadows

dialogue.t: Huh... Who'd have thought there'd be such a huge space underneath this volcano?
And it's wall-to-wall Abyss in here... Now that Paimon thinks about it, the Abyss covering the entrance probably crawled up from down here...
O Chosen of Dragons, the power of blazing fire now rests within you...
Go forth and vanquish the great enemy cloaked in shadow!
Huh. What's this fuzzy warm strength Paimon feels all over...?
Eh, that's a "later" question. Let's use it to send the Abyss packing, right here and now!

quests.description: The Heart of the Sacred Mountain is infested by the Abyss. Its influence must be eliminated.
